description.value: Super 8 Cranbrook is a franchised budget motel on the main commercial strip of Cranbrook, part of the Wyndham Hotels family. Cranbrook serves as a gateway to the East Kootenay region and the surrounding mountains, making it a natural overnight stop for touring cyclists on Highway 3 or the Columbia Valley corridor. As a nationally recognized chain property, it offers a predictable, no-surprises stay in a town with good access to services.
